parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region of the data management center. Select the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are outside China.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The user ID of a member. An administrator can specify this parameter to query alerts from the perspective of the member.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The view type.

- 0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: The view of all accounts in the enterprise.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.
